On perusal of the counter affidavit filed by the Collector and District Magistrate,
Sundargarh-Opposite Party No.2, it appears that steps are being taken for acquisition of land as per the provisions under Section 41 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Such a statement in the counter affidavit is vogue and illusive.
3. The Collector and District Magistrate, Sundargarh should have provided the details of the steps taken for acquisition of the land of the Petitioner, which is being occupied and utilized by the Government.
A common citizen should not be deprived of his/her right to exercise property right over land in such manner.
4. Hence, this Court, expressing its displeasure over the inaction of the Collector and District Simanta Kalo And Others vs State Of Odisha And Others .... Opp. ... on 6 March, 2026
